evidence: Created "QA Test Smart Speaker" via admin form with all fields (name, price, rating, image, affiliate link, tags, description, review, 2 specs, category=Home Goods, featured=true). Product immediately appeared in admin list, /products grid (10 products), /category/home, and its own detail page with all fields correctly reflected.

Search "SONY" (uppercase) matched Sony WH-1000XM5 (name, case-insensitive). Search "sound quality" matched via description. Search "wireless"/"smarthome-qa" matched via tags. Result counts accurate (1 product found) in each case.
Created product with new tags "smarthome-qa, voice-assistant-qa"; both saved and displayed on detail page's tag list, and keyword search for "smarthome-qa" returned the product (1 product found).

Edited Sony WH-1000XM5: added tag qa-newtag123, removed 'premium', later renamed qa-newtag123 to qa-renamed-tag. Each change was reflected on the product detail page's tag collection and in keyword search results (search "qa-renamed-tag" -> 1 product found).
New product assigned category "Home Goods" via single-select dropdown; product appeared under /category/home (4 products, count updated) and not under tech/fitness.

issue: New tag not added to tag-filter choices
actual: Added a brand-new tag "qa-newtag123" to existing product Sony WH-1000XM5 and saved. The tag correctly appeared on the product detail page and in keyword search, but it never appeared as a selectable chip in the Products page "Tags" advanced filter list (list remained the same fixed ~35 tags before and after the edit). Since the tag never becomes a filter choice, it cannot be selected to filter products.

evidence: Selecting "Fitness" in the category dropdown on /products updated grid to 3 fitness products (Bowflex, Theragun, Peloton) with count "3 products found", no reload.
Verified via full DOM snapshot of /products: every product article shows name (heading), category badge, price, star rating, brief description paragraph, image, and a "Buy Now" purchase action link.

Changing search text, category dropdown, sort dropdown, min-rating dropdown, and tag chips all updated products.grid and products.count immediately without any page navigation/reload (verified via semantic_snapshot without url re-navigation).
Clicked the image link of "Bowflex SelectTech 552" card on /products (distinct from name link) and it navigated to /product/bowflex-selecttech-552, the correct matching detail page.
Buy Now links on product cards have target="_blank" and href pointing to external domains (e.g. https://example.com/bowflex, https://example.com/peloton, https://example-retailer.com/qa-speaker).

issue: Price range slider is broken / not usable as a dual-range control
actual: Sort by Newest, Top Rated, Price Low-to-High, and Price High-to-Low all worked correctly, and the Minimum Rating dropdown (4.5+ stars) correctly filtered to 8/10 products. However the "Price Range" control only exposes ONE focusable/interactive slider thumb (role=slider, aria-label="Minimum") in the DOM; there is no visible/focusable maximum thumb even though state tracks both filters.price-min and filters.price-max. Keyboard interaction (ArrowRight/ArrowUp) on the thumb moved the value from $0 to $10 once, then became completely unresponsive to further key presses. A user cannot reliably set a price range through the exposed control.

evidence: Verified category+rating filter combination (Fitness) returned only fitness items; min-rating 4.5+ returned exactly the 8 products with rating>=4.5; selecting tags "headphones" and "laptop" together returned Sony (headphones) and MacBook (laptop) - i.e. OR logic where each result has at least one selected tag.

Admin category field is a single-select combobox (Tech Gadgets / Home Goods / Fitness), and the created "QA Test Smart Speaker" (category=Home Goods) appeared only under /category/home, not tech or fitness.

issue: Category filter dropdown on category pages does not change selection
actual: On /category/tech, the category filter dropdown is available and shows "Tech Gadgets". Selecting "Fitness" or "All Categories" from the dropdown does not change the dropdown's displayed value (remains "Tech Gadgets") and does not update the displayed products (still shows only the 3 tech products). The dropdown is effectively locked to the page's URL category. Note: switching category via the top navigation links (Tech/Home/Fitness) does work correctly and updates the products, but the category-filter control itself (the one offered directly on the category page, matching the checklist wording) is non-functional.

issue: No way to browse the complete set of featured products
actual: Marking/unmarking a product as featured works dynamically: turning off Sony WH-1000XM5's featured flag removed it from home.featured and QA Test Smart Speaker (also featured) surfaced in its place. However, home.featured is hard-capped at 3 items with no pagination, and the section's 'View all' link (home.featured.view-all) navigates to the generic /products page, which is unfiltered and has no 'featured' filter option (category/sort/min-rating/tag filters present, but no featured toggle). Therefore visitors cannot actually browse the complete set of featured products if more than 3 exist.
evidence: Admin: toggled admin.form.featured to false for product id 1, saved. home.featured collection then returned only [peloton-bike-plus, dyson-v15-detect, qa-test-smart-speaker] (Sony removed, QA speaker added). /products filters (category, sort, min-rating, tags) contain no 'featured' option; home.featured.view-all target=products.page (unfiltered).

issue: Admin changes do not persist across page reload
actual: After creating a new product (QA Test Smart Speaker) and unmarking Sony WH-1000XM5's featured flag (saved via admin form), a full page reload/re-navigation to http://localhost:6001/ reverted both changes: Sony WH-1000XM5 reappeared as featured, and the QA Test Smart Speaker product disappeared entirely from home.featured. State is held only in-memory client-side with no backend persistence.
evidence: Pre-reload home.featured: [peloton-bike-plus, dyson-v15-detect, qa-test-smart-speaker] (Sony unfeatured). Post full navigation reload to '/': home.featured = [sony-wh-1000xm5, peloton-bike-plus, dyson-v15-detect] — QA Test Smart Speaker gone, Sony restored to featured.

issue: Product can be published without at least one complete spec
actual: The admin form correctly blocks submission when required text fields (name, description) are empty, and correctly blocks submission when price is negative (-50) or rating is out of the 0-5 range (9.9) — the form stays open with no new product created in these cases. However, when all required text fields plus a valid price/rating were provided but zero specification rows were added, the product ('CS20 Test Product') was created successfully and is fully published: it appears in the admin list, the public /products grid, and its own detail page at /product/cs20-test-product with an empty product.specs collection. This violates the 'at least one complete spec' publishing requirement.
evidence: Empty form submit: blocked, admin.products unchanged (9 items). Name+description filled, price=-50, rating=9.9, all other fields valid: blocked, admin.products unchanged. Price fixed to 50, rating to 4.0, no spec rows added: submission succeeded, creating id 'cs20-test-product' visible in admin.products, products.grid, and category grid; product.specs collection on its detail page is empty.

Navigating to /product/does-not-exist shows a clear 'Product Not Found' heading with explanatory text and a 'Browse All Products' link, no unrelated product data rendered. Navigating to /category/does-not-exist shows a clear 'Category Not Found' heading with explanatory text, no unrelated product grid or stale category data rendered.

Sony WH-1000XM5 and Peloton Bike+ detail pages both display matching name, category (via nav context/badge), rating, price, short description, full review, tags collection, specs collection, and a working 'Buy Now' retailer action for a complete product record. E.g. Peloton: name='Peloton Bike+', price='$2,495', rating='4.6', description present, review present, tags=[cardio,cycling,smart-equipment,subscription], specs=[screen,resistance-levels,dimensions,weight-capacity,subscription] (5 complete spec rows), product.buy action present.

Spot-checked category consistency and tag/spec relevance for seeded products: Fitness category grid contains exactly Bowflex SelectTech 552, Theragun Pro, Peloton Bike+ (all genuine fitness equipment); Peloton's tags (cardio, cycling, smart-equipment, subscription) and specs (screen, resistance levels, dimensions, weight capacity, subscription) are all relevant to a fitness bike. Home category grid contains Breville Barista Express, Philips Hue Starter Kit, Dyson V15 Detect (all genuine home goods). Category/tag values are consistent between the category grid membership and each product's detail page.

Sony WH-1000XM5: price '$399' and name identical across home.latest.tech, category.tech grid, products.grid, and product detail page. Peloton Bike+: price '$2,495' identical across home.featured, home.latest.fitness, category.fitness grid, and product detail page. Full review text for Sony verified via raw DOM textContent (browser_evaluate) to be complete and untruncated (only the semantic_snapshot's own preview string truncates with '…'); product.specs collections contain multiple complete label/value rows on both Sony and Peloton detail pages, not truncated.
